steps.name: install-and-correct-closed-loop-core
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 24204b287617422057f5a43066606e719570c68b; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage8a/climate_policy.py > tools/ml/climate_policy.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage8a/climate_benchmark.py > tools/ml/climate_benchmark.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage8a/test_climate_benchmark.py > tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tools/ml/climate_policy.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''            current_temp_score = abs(temperature_error) / 5.0
            outside_temp_score = abs(state.outside_temperature_c - targets.air_temperature_c) / 5.0
            current_humidity_error, current_humidity_scale = _humidity_error(
                state.air_temperature_c,
                state.relative_humidity_pct,
                targets,
                profile.humidity_control_mode,
            )
            outside_humidity_error, outside_humidity_scale = _humidity_error(
                state.outside_temperature_c,
                state.outside_humidity_pct,
                targets,
                profile.humidity_control_mode,
            )
            current_score = current_temp_score + abs(current_humidity_error) / current_humidity_scale
            outside_score = outside_temp_score + abs(outside_humidity_error) / outside_humidity_scale
            improvement = current_score - outside_score
            if improvement > cfg.outside_improvement_margin:
                values["exhaust_fan"] = _clip(improvement / 1.5)
'''
new='''            mix_fraction = 0.20
            mixed_temperature = state.air_temperature_c + mix_fraction * (
                state.outside_temperature_c - state.air_temperature_c
            )
            mixed_humidity = state.relative_humidity_pct + mix_fraction * (
                state.outside_humidity_pct - state.relative_humidity_pct
            )
            current_temp_score = abs(temperature_error) / 5.0
            mixed_temp_score = abs(mixed_temperature - targets.air_temperature_c) / 5.0
            current_humidity_error, current_humidity_scale = _humidity_error(
                state.air_temperature_c,
                state.relative_humidity_pct,
                targets,
                profile.humidity_control_mode,
            )
            mixed_humidity_error, mixed_humidity_scale = _humidity_error(
                mixed_temperature,
                mixed_humidity,
                targets,
                profile.humidity_control_mode,
            )
            current_score = current_temp_score + abs(current_humidity_error) / current_humidity_scale
            mixed_score = mixed_temp_score + abs(mixed_humidity_error) / mixed_humidity_scale
            improvement = current_score - mixed_score
            if improvement > cfg.outside_improvement_margin:
                values["exhaust_fan"] = _clip(improvement / 0.75)
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected outside-air scoring block not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
.venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_policy.py tools/ml/climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_policy.py tools/ml/climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-closed-loop-gate
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py tests/test_climate_training.py -q; .venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/climate_policy.py tools/ml/climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/climate_policy.py tools/ml/climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/climate_policy.py tools/ml/climate_benchmark.py tests/test_climate_benchmark.py; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add climate v6 closed-loop benchmark core'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
